source.check: retiring member continuing without nomination (only three nominations for the fourteen divisions; 'all the other outgoing members were automatically returned', Frontier Sentinel, 29 April 1933, p. 5); present at the new council's annual meeting, Tuesday 30 May 1933 (Newry Reporter, 1 June 1933, p. 7)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Only three candidates were nominated for the fourteen divisions; all the other outgoing members were automatically returned and there were no contests. Those placed by the new council's annual meeting (30 May 1933) are added with their divisions inferred from the 1930 return; Ballycoshone, Clonduff, Crobane and Rathfriland North and South are not yet placed. No nomination was received; the retiring member continued in office (deemed re-elected), not a co-option. Division inferred from the 1930 return (Newry Reporter, 3 May 1930, p. 2 and Newry Telegraph, 3 May 1930, p. 2); the Newry Reporter, 1 June 1933, p. 7 places the member on the new council at its first meeting. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
